10.  Award  Contract for Joe Machado Field ( JMF) Concession Stand

  City Councilmember Sarah De La Rosa recused herself due to a Conflict of Interest with
  one of the applicants.  Authorized the City Manager to negotiate and execute an
  agreement with Francisco Rojo for the operations at the snack bar concession at Joe
  Machado Field and that the City Council waive any irregularities in the proposal.
  Motion to approve made by Anni Marshall, seconded by Lisa Lavelle. ( 4 Ayes -Marshall,
